text:
Amelia R: morning team — quick heads up: new hire Jonas T's passport renewal is still in progress. He flies in on Monday and needs access + badge same day.
Raj P: hi — what's the ETA on the passport? can he use any secondary docs for I-9?
People Ops (Pia): per policy we accept passport OR passport card OR drivers license + SSN card. if passport is pending, we can do a remote I-9 exception with in-person verification within 3 days.
Jonas T: passport says renewed but the new one won't arrive until Tue (overnight shipping delayed). I can bring my expired passport + gov renewal receipt + driver's license.
Lisa HR: that should work for a 3-day exception. we'll need to log the receipt and then verify the new passport when it arrives. I'll attach the exception form.
IT Ops: for Monday access — do we need to ship a loaner laptop, or can Jonas pick up at office? badge needed for door and Mac provisioning.
Amelia R: prefer pick up to avoid courier delays. Jonas will be onsite for orientation 9am-2pm, can queue at front desk.
Raj P: question on courier — we had a last-minute courier swap last month. courier-bot, can you confirm pickup window for Monday morning?
courier-bot: Pickup slots available 07:30-09:30. Next-day delivery to SF office guaranteed if scheduled today. Tracking: `CR-84291`.
People Ops (Pia): action items: 1) Lisa to open I-9 exception form and attach renewal receipt; 2) IT Ops to stage laptop at reception; 3) Amelia to assign onboarding buddy; 4) Raj to confirm desk and parking pass.
Lisa HR: on it — I created a case: HR-4472. I'll DM Jonas the secure upload link for the renewal receipt.
IT Ops: Laptop imaged and labeled. `Asset: LTP-3220` assigned to Jonas; will hold at reception under "Jonas T - onboarding".
Amelia R: assigning buddy — @Raj P will be Jonas's buddy for first week unless anyone objects. Raj? :wave:
Raj P: happy to. I'll meet him at 8:45 to walk over and introduce team.
Jonas T: thanks everyone — appreciate the flexibility. I'll upload the receipt tonight.
People Ops (Pia): tiny reminder on benefits enrollment: we'll run a walk-through at 10:30 in conf A — Jonas should bring legal name + dependent info if enrolling dependents.
Raj P: also note — we'll add Jonas to Slack + calendar. Lisa, please add him to the "new-hires" invite so calendar invites are auto-populated.
Lisa HR: added to invite. benefits packet link: https://redwood-internal/benefits/packet-2026.pdf
Amelia R: closing checklist: I-9 exception logged, laptop reserved, buddy assigned, courier not needed. If passport arrives early, Jonas will bring it to reception and Lisa will complete final verification. :thumbsup:
Jonas T: will do. See you Monday! :smile:
